subject: physics_2
question_text: Derive an expression for the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor.

verification.note: The 1+1+1+1 mark split is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. Two structural checks are IMPOSSIBLE for this paper: the two-book union check (the TSBIE Basic Learning Material on hand is first-year physics only) and the past-paper back-test (the paper corpus holds only Paper-I papers). Hand-checked: σ = q/A, E = σ/ε₀ between plates, V = Ed = qd/Aε₀, C = q/V = ε₀A/d, and Kε₀A/d with a dielectric — matches the book (its 'vaccum' and 'permitivity' spellings corrected).

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

steps.label: The figure
steps.margin_note: Two plates a distance d apart, charge +q and −q, surface density σ, uniform field E between them.
steps.why: Every symbol of the derivation — σ, E, d — is a length or arrow on this picture, so the three steps below just read the figure.
common_mistakes: Drawing field arrows outside the plates. The field of the pair lives between them.

recall.must_convey: That two parallel plates are drawn distance d apart with charges +q and −q and the field E between them.
accept: draw two plates distance d apart
reject: C equals epsilon nought A by d

steps.memory_tip: Two vertical lines, arrows across the gap, one d below.

steps.label: The field between the plates
lines: Two plates, each of area A, are a small
distance d apart with vacuum (or air) between
them. A charge q on a plate spreads to a
The field between the plates is uniform:
steps.margin_note: First mark. σ = q/A and the uniform field E = σ/ε₀.
steps.why: The two charged sheets each contribute σ/2ε₀ between the plates and cancel outside — that is why the field inside is the full σ/ε₀ and is the same at every point of the gap.
common_mistakes: Writing E = σ/2ε₀ — that is ONE sheet alone; the pair gives σ/ε₀ between them.
Treating E as falling off with distance. Between close plates it is uniform.

recall.must_convey: That sigma is q by A and the uniform field between the plates is sigma by epsilon-nought.
accept: E is sigma by epsilon nought

steps.memory_tip: Two half-fields σ/2ε₀ add inside the gap and cancel outside.

steps.label: The potential difference
lines: For a uniform field, the potential difference
between the plates is field times separation:

lines.text: V = E d = q d / Aε₀

steps.margin_note: Second mark. V = Ed holds because E is the same all the way across.
steps.why: Potential difference is the work per unit charge across the gap; with E constant that work is simply E times the distance d — no integral is needed here.
common_mistakes: Writing V = E/d. Field times distance, not field over distance.

recall.must_convey: That V equals E times d, which is q d by A epsilon-nought.
accept: q d by A epsilon nought

steps.memory_tip: Uniform field: cross the gap at a steady rate, so V is just E times d.

steps.label: The capacitance
lines: Capacitance is charge per unit potential

lines.text: C = q / V = q / (q d / Aε₀)

steps.margin_note: Third mark. Divide q by V and watch q cancel out.
steps.why: The charge q cancels, so C depends only on the geometry A and d and on the medium — a capacitor's value is built into its shape, not into how much charge it happens to carry.
common_mistakes: Leaving q in the final answer — it must cancel.
Inverting to C = d/ε₀A. Larger area means LARGER capacitance.

recall.must_convey: That C is q by V and the q cancels, leaving epsilon-nought A by d.
reject: K epsilon nought A by d

steps.memory_tip: Area on top, distance below: big close plates store the most.

steps.label: With a dielectric
lines: With a dielectric of dielectric constant K
filling the space between the plates,
K > 1, so a dielectric increases the
steps.margin_note: Last mark. Replace ε₀ by Kε₀ and say that C increases K times.
steps.why: The dielectric's induced charges weaken the field inside to E/K, so the same q needs less V — and less V per q is exactly a larger C.
common_mistakes: Dividing by K instead of multiplying. The FIELD falls by K; the CAPACITANCE rises by K.

recall.must_convey: That with a dielectric the capacitance becomes K epsilon-nought A by d, K times larger.
accept: K epsilon nought A by d

steps.memory_tip: The dielectric divides E and multiplies C — same K, opposite directions.

insider_note: Four marks, four boxes of working: σ and E, then V = Ed, then the cancellation in q/V, then the K factor. The q cancelling is the step examiners look for.
